name: Voxel Format Generation
definition: Converts 3D Gaussian Splats into a sparse voxel octree for collision detection, outputting metadata (.voxel.json) and binary data (.voxel.bin), optionally generating a .collision.glb mesh.
summary: Voxel Format Generation converts 3D Gaussian Splats into sparse voxel octrees optimized for collision detection, distinguishing itself by integrating topology analysis to generate watertight meshes directly from the grid.
